name: stocktake
description: Count what a tracker board claims against what the codebase actually holds, card by card, and move each one to the column its evidence supports. Reads every comment and attached image and rebuilds the numbered requirement list from the ticket BEFORE opening any completion record or diff, because a diff read first supplies the frame and the requirements it silently dropped never enter the list. Locates the work — merged, on a branch nobody merged, unpushed, in a worktree, or never built — then traces each requirement to the code that PRODUCES its value rather than to a surface that renders it, and judges whether the tests standing behind it could actually fail: which rung of oracle each critical requirement stands on, armed and unarmed assertions counted apart, a denominator for what the gate really runs. Grades every verdict out of family with a single strongest judge rather than a panel, because nine frontier judges across seven families supply about two independent votes. An inconclusive result blocks and never rounds up to a pass. Cards with work left get a brief written for ship-fleet to orchestrate; cards with open decisions get referred to another model family or decided with a named recommendation rather than parked on the reader; cards whose evidence holds are promoted to Done — and never past it into a human's column until eight named preconditions hold for one pre-registered low-risk class, which a bundled gate refuses by default. Use whenever someone asks to triage, sweep, review, reconcile or clean up a board or backlog, asks what is left across a set of tickets, asks whether items in a review column are genuinely done, asks which tickets sit in the wrong status, or says a column has piled up. At Done, the column a card may reach is decided by the `warrant` plugin rather than by a checklist: warrant_column.py reads the signed warrant and the ratchet's last word and returns Verified where the card's defect class has earned warrant tier 3 with no revocation, Needs More Work where a warrant gate failed on the card's own evidence, and Done with every reason named otherwise. A grant states the substitution it rests on every time, because a warrant tier is earned by absence of escapes rather than by a measured non-inferiority study, and the signed warrant is a person accepting that in advance.
